query: What is Elon Musk's current net worth according to Bloomberg Billionaires Index in early July 2026? Has it recovered above $1 trillion after the late June 2026 tech selloff? Include recent Tesla and SpaceX share price and valuation trajectory.
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary:

**Elon Musk's net worth has NOT recovered above $1 trillion.** As of early-to-mid July 2026, he sits at approximately **$913 billion per the Bloomberg Billionaires Index** (July 10) and ~$917 billion per Forbes, remaining the world's richest person but below the trillion-dollar mark he first crossed in June 2026.

**Key trajectory:**
- **June 12, 2026:** SpaceX IPO'd on Nasdaq ($135 IPO price, opened $150), making Musk the world's first trillionaire.
- **June 16:** SpaceX peaked at $225.64, pushing his net worth to an all-time high of ~$1.4–1.45 trillion.
- **Late-June selloff:** SpaceX crashed 16.4% on June 22 (down >31% from peak), wiping ~$300–350B off his fortune.
- **Early-mid July:** Fell under $1 trillion; on July 13 dipped to $879.3B as SpaceX slid toward its $135 IPO price (~$140).

**Tesla (TSLA):** Closed $380.84 on July 17, 2026 (market cap ~$1.43T), down ~23.7% from its 52-week high of $498.83. **SpaceX (SPCX):** Declined from its $225.64 peak toward ~$140, nearing its IPO price — and since Musk holds ~42% of SpaceX, this drives most of his net-worth volatility.

No sign of recovery above $1 trillion as of the latest data (July 17, 2026); the trajectory through mid-July has been flat-to-downward.
